I will keep my land in the usual wheat and summer maize cycle. In Quzhou County, that is the system I trust most because I know how to manage it, the weather fits it, water use is familiar, and grain is easy to sell or keep. I would not make the year complicated with too many crops. At my age, I would choose the crops and field work I already understand well, use improved or hybrid seed where it clearly helps yield and standability, fertilize enough to secure production but not chase the very highest input level, and keep irrigation and pesticide use to the minimum that still protects the harvest. I would plough before wheat to set up a clean seedbed, then use rotary tillage after wheat harvest for quick summer maize planting so I do not lose time.
